description.text: The first special set of the Sword & Shield series, released on 25 September 2020 with 80 cards: 73 and 7 secret rares, and sold only in special collections. It is built around Galar's Gym Leaders and rivals and the Pokémon that battle beside them, with Pokémon V such as Lucario V, Eldegoss V and Duraludon V, three Pokémon VMAX, among them Drednaw VMAX and Alcremie VMAX, and 19 Trainer cards.
